methodology.scope: dev only; test is reserved for parent one-time regression after freeze, not unseen holdout
methodology.baseline_rule: IDF-weighted token coverage >=0.22 and (BM25>0 or character TF-IDF>=0.12)

changes: Chinese dictionary word segmentation with offline jieba HMM disabled replaces crossing bigrams
Generic function-word removal, conservative English inflection/identifier normalization
Keep original 0.22 IDF coverage gate for isolation; separate candidates from actually quoted sources
experiments.rationale: Unknown crossing Chinese bigrams and query scaffolding were incorrectly treated as factual requirements. Numeric/negation/factual unknowns remain tokens; no evaluation-specific synonyms.

changes: Raise content-word IDF coverage from legacy 0.22 to 0.35 after word segmentation
Reject absent explicit numeric/date constraints and unknown out-of-corpus technical identifiers
For numeric questions require an actual numeric value with relevant units and requested min/max/default qualifiers
experiments.rationale: Independent synthetic cases exposed false acceptance of a wrong release date, an unknown auth identifier, and an unspecified numeric upload limit. These generic constraints are not question-specific synonym lists; thresholds were raised, not relaxed.

changes: Preserve explicit negation and reject candidates missing negative wording
Treat broad qualitative size questions separately from exact numeric limits
experiments.rationale: Independent counterexamples exposed a positive statement accepted for a not-question, and small-files evidence wrongly rejected because qualitative size was forced into a numeric answer. No domain synonym list or dev/test answer tokens were added.

final.source_policy: Only up to three individually qualified excerpts receive citation IDs. All retrieved chunks remain non-supporting retrieval_candidates.
final.baseline_metric_caveat: expected_source_use_rate and unsupported_acceptance_rate were introduced by evaluator after baseline; not retroactively estimated. Baseline sources previously included unquoted candidates; its source-use metric is not comparable.
limits: Lexical gating is not semantic entailment or factual correctness verification.
Negation guard checks presence of negative wording, not its grammatical scope.
Dates/numbers and technical identifiers are lexical constraints; equivalent formats or unseen paraphrases can still be refused.
Qualitative excerpts cannot establish an unspecified exact numeric limit.
Development labels are AI-assisted source-checked drafts; no claim of independently validated benchmark.
Parent alone will run test once after freeze; that is regression, not unseen holdout.
